name: Red-Shouldered Ctenucha
desc: Red-Shouldered Ctenucha (Ctenucha rubroscapus): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 13 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Ctenucha rubroscapus, the Red-shouldered ctenucha moth, or the White-tipped ctenucha, is a moth of the family Erebidae. It was described by Édouard Ménétries in 1857.
